prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of lower back pain and muscle tightness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash. Over the course of 23 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication, following a typical recovery pathway. Visit frequency was reduced progressively as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Physical examination showed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which support the reported strain, while neurological screening, reflexes, and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the lumbar region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicate or repeated billing. The patient is expected to continue a self-directed exercise program and return only if symptoms recur.
